Questions, answered

Frequently asked questions

All FAQsContact us
Do you place both pharmacists and technicians?

Yes. We place hospital and clinical pharmacists and pharmacy technicians, including those with sterile compounding experience.

Are the roles retail or hospital?

Our focus is hospital, health-system and long-term care pharmacy. If you are looking for something else, tell us and we will let you know when it comes up.

Can I move my license to another state?

Pharmacist license transfer is handled state by state. We explain the steps for the state you want and build the timeline into your start date.
